svg.title: Facet architecture model: the core, its ports, and the platform adapters
svg.desc: FacetCore is the circle. Every platform capability leaves it through a named port. Each square is one capability's adapters, holding a slot per platform, of which the build selects one. What travels the arm is the same whichever slot is built. Six squares, evenly spaced at sixty degrees. Two capabilities were removed rather than drawn, and the comments say which and why.
svg.text: The shape Facet is being moved into
Inside the circle is the core. It knows nothing about the platform it runs on. Every platform capability leaves through a named port.
Each square holds one capability's adapters, a slot per platform, of which the build selects one. What travels the arm never changes.
DOES NOT KNOW WHAT IT IS RUNNING ON
modules inside link to one another freely
THREE THINGS GO GREEN, AT THREE DIFFERENT MOMENTS

g.text: The arm, once the port exists and something is handed over it. Amber and dashed until then.
One slot, once that platform's adapter sits in the square and its own composition root hands it over.
The square, only once every platform's adapter is done, so a green square means the capability is settled rather than started.
Black, where that platform's code is written but is not behind a port: the core reaches it directly, or it sits on the wrong side of the line.
Dashed, where nothing is written yet. The build selects one slot per square, and the core cannot tell which it got.

svg.text: The rule this draws is in CLAUDE.md, under "The core is platform-blind, and every platform capability is a port".
